findings.service_counter: Warm timber rectangle, thick planked top, four legs, lower longitudinal shelf/support; dark till at one physical end; keypad and screen face camp/staff side. Customer queue in B-008.00 approaches opposite side.
findings.processing_counter: Distinct low blue metal appliance with silver left/right trays, orange middle grille, small feet, control knob on one long face. A-016.00 places this in production, separate from customer service.
findings.scope_advice: Do not substitute processing apparatus for the requested customer counter. Preserve register position when rotating the service counter.
